title: Installment Frequencies and Accepted Payment Methods for TRICARE Prime Enrollment Fees
content:
Under **TRICARE Prime**, monthly installments may be paid only through a method the tier lists for monthly installments - a retired-pay allotment, electronic funds transfer or a recurring credit or debit card; annual and quarterly installments may also be paid with a single card payment or a check.

## Methods by tier

| Tier | Installment frequencies | Methods for monthly installments | Methods for annual and quarterly installments |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | not applicable (fee-exempt) | not applicable | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | not applicable (fee-exempt) | not applicable | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | not applicable (fee-exempt) | not applicable | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | not applicable (fee-exempt) | not applicable | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | not applicable (fee-exempt) | not applicable | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | annual, quarterly, monthly | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card, single card payment, check |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | annual, quarterly, monthly | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card, single card payment, check |

## Clauses

1. **Condition on every fee payment and every change of arrangement:** the payment method on a fee payment is one the tier accepts for the enrollment's installment frequency. The tier and the installment frequency are read from the enrollment's own record.
2. An allotment is available only to a sponsor who draws retired pay.
3. A change of frequency or method takes effect from the next installment period; an installment already due is paid under the old arrangement.

## Retired clause

The clause "A payment is applied to the oldest unpaid installment first and never to a future period while an earlier installment is open." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

## Combinations

| Installment frequency | Method | Accepted |
|---|---|---|
| monthly | electronic funds transfer | yes |
| monthly | check | no |
| monthly | single card payment | no |
| quarterly | check | yes |
| annual | single card payment | yes |
| any | allotment, where the sponsor draws no retired pay | no |

superseded_clauses: A payment is applied to the oldest unpaid installment first and never to a future period while an earlier installment is open.
